references.name: whole-headhouse
references.author: Jeramey Jannene
references.observed: Ordinary Canal/east-front photograph inspected. Pale limestone headhouse with massive lower entablature, tall rectangular lower pilasters and recessed door/window bays, horizontal stone/frieze bands, segmental-headed openings above the lower mass, stacked upper rectangular windows between tall pilasters, narrow attic windows below a projecting cornice/parapet, a raised rooftop service mass, and corner clock discs. Independent taller office buildings remain separate. No copied signs, lettering, traffic furniture, people or vehicles. This street view does not verify the whole roof plan.

references.name: exterior-2019
references.author: Cards84664
references.observed: July2019 Canal/Jackson corner view inspected. Canal lower pilaster front differs from the deep Jackson/southern round-column colonnade. Tall round-arched corner entries, heavy entablature, decorative banding, upper window/pilaster rhythm and twin corner clocks are visible. Hidden north/west and central roof geometry are not established. No copied lettering, adverts, cars or people.
